summary:
**UI score: 9.0/10 for the current simplification. No blocking findings.** Visual consistency looks strong, though exact web similarity is not established by these captures alone.

- Navigation now shows only brand + Library. Management actions share one menu implementation, reused by Library’s Options.
- Welcome has one clear Open Library action. Import remains discoverable inside Library.
- No “Try demo” UI entry remains in the inspected app source. `--ui-fixture` remains an explicit testing path.
- Reviewed 480-point and 125% captures show no horizontal overflow; controls wrap and content scrolls vertically.
- GUI evidence records successful Library → importer dismissal and Account navigation.

Minor objections:

- “Open Library” opens the playlist sheet, while “Open library…” opens a file. That naming overlap could confuse first-time users ([NativeLibraryView.swift:420](/Users/gustavocaiano/.t3/worktrees/tubeshuffle/t3-310b873b/macos/TubeShuffle/App/NativeLibraryView.swift:420)).
- “Options” hides Account and file management behind a generic label, a reasonable discoverability tradeoff for the requested simplicity ([NativeLibraryView.swift:462](/Users/gustavocaiano/.t3/worktrees/tubeshuffle/t3-310b873b/macos/TubeShuffle/App/NativeLibraryView.swift:462)).

Limits: read-only source/evidence review. Welcome and empty Library are packaged-app captures; playback/Focus/zoom use synthetic media. Validation records 247 passes, two skips, and successful packaging checks; I did not rerun them. This does not establish live playback, authentication, or release acceptance.
